overview_description: Read milestones in Exsited: list them all, list them by account, labour or employee, or retrieve one.
intro: Milestones mark progress points in Exsited work. You can list every milestone, list the milestones of one account, labour or employee, and retrieve one milestone. This area has 5 endpoints, and all seven SDKs call every one.
notes: **The milestone calls only read.** This area has no create, update or delete call.
**The employee route takes the employee's `code`.** Passing the `emp_` id returns `404`.
**A single milestone is read by its `wfm_` id or raw uuid.** A workflow's milestone definition is a different record and returns `404`.
**The listings return `data` and `pagination`.** An account, labour or employee with no milestones returns an empty `data` list.

endpoints.title: List milestones
endpoints.summary: Lists milestones, one page at a time.
endpoints.description: Returns one page of milestones under `data`, with `pagination` for the next page. Any other field of the record filters the listing as `filter_<field>` or `filter_<field>_<operator>`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, to fetch the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by; prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

endpoints.title: List an account's milestones
endpoints.summary: Lists the milestones that belong to one account.
endpoints.description: Returns the account's milestones under `data`, with `pagination`. An account with no milestones returns an empty `data` list.

endpoints.title: List a labour's milestones
endpoints.summary: Lists the milestones that belong to one labour.
endpoints.description: Returns the labour's milestones under `data`, with `pagination`. A labour with no milestones returns an empty `data` list.

endpoints.title: List an employee's milestones
endpoints.summary: Lists the milestones that belong to one employee, found by the employee's code.
endpoints.description: Returns the employee's milestones under `data`, with `pagination`. The path takes the employee's `code`; an `emp_` id returns `404`. Any other field of the record filters the listing as `filter_<field>` or `filter_<field>_<operator>`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` of the previous page, to fetch the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by; prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

404.description: No employee has that code. An `emp_` id in place of the code also returns `404`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve a milestone
endpoints.summary: Retrieves one milestone by its `wfm_` id or raw uuid.
endpoints.description: Returns the milestone under `milestone`. A workflow's milestone definition is a different record and returns `404` here.

parameters.name: milestone_uuid
parameters.description: The milestone's `id`, which starts with `wfm_`, or its raw uuid.

404.description: No milestone has that id. The id of a workflow's milestone definition also returns `404`.

limit.description: The page size applied to this page.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows. Rely on this rather than on `next_cursor`, which can still hold a value on the last page.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page.
